parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You will hear a man taking part in a survey about his local community. First, you will have some time to look at questions one to six.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to six.

Hi, Altaf. I'm your settlement worker, and I'm called Jenny. It's great to meet you. Welcome to our city. You'll love Toronto.

I'm sure I will.

I have some general recommendations. First, Toronto's a big place. A lot of people who come here choose to live in the west.

I see. Is there a reason for that?

Well, yes. There's a great market in the neighborhood. All the local people know about it.

Oh, that would be good for us.

And I understand you have young children?

That's right.

So another advantage of this area is that it has quite a few parks where children can play.

Oh, that's great. They really like being outside.

I actually know of an apartment in the area that's available. I'll arrange for you to see it, but first let's look at the floor plan, and I'll tell you what to check when you see it. This room here is the kitchen. Be sure to open the refrigerator.

To see if it's working properly?

Yes, and to make sure that there's no nasty smell.

Oh [laughs] . Anything else?

Well, it would be good to check the electrical situation. There's nothing worse than not having enough plugs. You'll need at least four.

I'll look for those. Um, what's this on the plan?

Well, now, that's the living room, and this is where you go outside to a small balcony. Have a look at the door lock. Be sure it's not broken.

I will. It'll be nice to have our own place to sit outside when we want.

Yes, it's very nice on a summer evening after dinner. And Altaf, have a good look around the living room. The condition of the room is important because it's your main living area. Look at the paint in particular. It may be time to redo it.

I'll check that.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten.

Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.

Now, Altaf, this hall leads to the bathroom.

When you look at that, do check below the sink. Often that's the place you'll find a leak. And the tiles in the bathroom should be in good shape.

I agree. Then this room must be one of the bedrooms, and this must be the closet. My wife wants a large one.

I'm sure. We all want lots of room for our clothes. You'll also want to look outside the bedroom window. It overlooks the street, and there might be a lot of noise at all times of the day and night. We're in a very busy city.

I see. That would be a problem for my wife and the boys too. I'll definitely remember to check that.

Jenny, what other things are in the building?

You mean the facilities?

Yes. For example, where will we do our laundry?

With a building of this type, it's probably in the basement, but it doesn't say. So you'll need to check where it is. You know what's also really good to check for?

No, what?

You need to check that there's a garbage room on every floor. Then you don't need to go outside.

Right.

Well, that's everything for now. Good luck, Altaf. We'll talk later today.

Thanks for your help, Jenny.

That is the end of part one. You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.

analyses.content: 录音中提到很多人选择住在多伦多的西部（west），这直接对应了题目中的热门居住地（popular place to live）。
你可能会在听到Toronto后就停止寻找答案，但题目问的是具体的方位，需要注意听表示人们选择居住的地点名词。
I have some general recommendations. First, Toronto's a big place. A lot of people who come here choose to live in the west. I see.
录音提到附近有一个很棒的市场（market），且当地人都知道，这对应了题目中的“众所周知”（well-known）。
你可能会没听出“All the local people know about it”是对well-known的替换表达，从而导致没能把前面的修饰对象market写下来。
Is there a reason for that? Well, yes. There's a great market in the neighborhood. All the local people know about it.
录音中提到这个区域有相当多供孩子玩耍的公园（parks），“quite a few”对应了题目中的“几个”（several）。
你可能会将注意力全放在孩子（children）上，而忽略了紧跟在数量词后面的真正主语parks。
And I understand you have young children? That's right. So another advantage of this area is that it has quite a few parks where children can play. Oh, that's great.
录音中明确提醒要确保冰箱里没有难闻的气味（smell），“nasty”对应了题目中的bad。
你可能会根据前文中男士说的“working properly”误填状态词，从而错过了后面女士补充的真正问题点。
Be sure to open the refrigerator. To see if it's working properly? Yes, and to make sure that there's no nasty smell.
录音提到去阳台时要检查门锁（lock）确保它没坏，没坏（not broken）对应题目中的“完好”（is OK）。
你可能会在听到阳台（balcony）后一直在等后面的答案，却忽略了答案door lock其实就在它之后紧接着出现。
And this is where you go outside to a small balcony. Have a look at the door lock. Be sure it's not broken. I will.
录音中特别强调了要看一下房间里的油漆（paint），可能需要重新刷，这正好是在说明房间的状况（condition）。
你可能会在听到condition之后只理解了宏观语义，而忽略了紧跟其后的具体检查项paint。
The condition of the room is important because it's your main living area. Look at the paint in particular. It may be time to redo it. I'll check that.
录音指出要检查水槽（sink）下方，因为通常那里会发现漏水（leak），对应了题目中寻找的对象。
你可能听到了sink，但在听写时只注意到了下方的空间，而漏掉了实际上需要寻找的具体问题leak。
Now, Altaf, this hall leads to the bathroom. When you look at that, do check below the sink. Often that's the place you'll find a leak.
录音提到窗户俯瞰街道，可能日夜都会有很多噪音（noise），“a lot of”对应题目的amount of。
句子较长，你可能会被前置的参照物street分散注意力，忽略了修饰语a lot of后面的核心名词noise。
You'll also want to look outside the bedroom window. It overlooks the street, and there might be a lot of noise at all times of the day and night. We're in a very busy city. I see.
男士询问洗衣服（laundry）的地方在哪，女士说可能在地下室，需要去确认位置（location）。
你可能会过度关注括号里的提示词basement，而忘记了前文中引出整个话题的核心词laundry。
For example, where will we do our laundry? With a building of this type, it's probably in the basement, but it doesn't say. So you'll need to check where it is.
录音提醒需要检查每一层（every floor）是否都有垃圾（garbage）房，对应了题目中的“一个……的地方”。
你可能只听到room而没填garbage，但题目问的是这层楼具体用途的空间，只填宏观概念会导致语义不完整而丢分。
You know what's also really good to check for? No. What? You need to check that there's a garbage room on every floor. Then you don't need to go outside.
